describe:
BMI Check, in the ocean colours.
You can change: "Weight (kg)": number, starts at 70; "Height (cm)": number, starts at 170.
Works out:
- m is cm divided by 100.
- bmi is kg divided by the result of m times m when m is more than 0, otherwise 0.
- lo is 18.5 times m times m.
- hi is 24.9 times m times m.
- band is "Enter your weight and height" when bmi is 0, otherwise "Underweight" when bmi is less than 18.5, otherwise "Healthy weight" when bmi is less than 25, otherwise "Overweight" when bmi is less than 30, otherwise "Obese".
